title: Choosing the Right Representations: Task-Aware Fusion for Multimodal Materials Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.24641v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal language models for materials science rely on effective mechanisms for incorporating three-dimensional structural representations. MatterChat addresses this challenge using a large bridge module between a pretrained structural encoder and the LLM, together with a separate contrastive alignment stage. We instead ask whether this bridge can adaptively select and combine representations from multiple structural encoders according to the target property. We find that supervised and generative material encoders provide complementary information for property prediction. We found that, for Zatom-1, this information is not concentrated in the final layer. Instead, the most informative representations occur at different depths depending on the target property. translated_title: 选择正确的表征：面向多模态材料语言模型的任务感知融合
translated_abstract: 面向材料科学的多模态语言模型依赖于将三维结构表征有效融入模型的机制。MatterChat 通过在预训练结构编码器与大语言模型（LLM）之间使用一个大型桥接模块，并结合一个独立的对比对齐阶段来应对这一挑战。我们则提出另一个问题：该桥接模块能否根据目标性质自适应地选择并组合来自多个结构编码器的表征？我们发现，监督式与生成式的材料编码器在性质预测中提供了互补的信息。我们还发现，对于 Zatom-1，这些信息并不集中在最后一层；相反，最具信息量的表征出现在不同的网络深度，具体取决于目标性质。这一发现启发了任务条件化注意力融合的设计，这是一种轻量级的基于注意力的桥接方法，它使用任务条件化的潜在查询将 CHGNet 特征与中间层表征相结合……
tldr: 该论文提出了轻量级的任务条件化注意力融合桥接模块，能够根据目标性质自适应地从多个结构编码器的不同深度选择并融合互补的表征，从而提升多模态材料语言模型的性质预测能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Task-Conditioned Attention Fusion (TCAF), a lightweight attention-based bridge that adaptively selects and combines complementary representations from multiple structural encoders at different depths according to the target property, enhancing multimodal materials language models for property prediction.
